evidenceSemantics: Checklist completion records deployment evidence only. It does not create hardware qualification, production signing trust, or release-stage promotion.

requiredChecks.requirement: Windows edition/version/build and x64 architecture must match a source-controlled support-matrix entry.
requiredChecks.evidence: platform identity plus support-matrix entry id

requiredChecks.requirement: Persistent engine service identity must be explicitly recorded and its required access verified.
requiredChecks.evidence: service identity and deployment qualification record

requiredChecks.requirement: Application, state, log, certificate and update paths must have reviewed ACLs appropriate to the selected service identity.
Application, persistent state, diagnostics and recording storage locations must be declared and capacity/recovery expectations reviewed.
GPU identity and driver must match an evidence-backed support-matrix tuple before being called supported.
requiredChecks.evidence: GPU identity, driver version and qualification evidence reference

requiredChecks.requirement: Media I/O provider, device, driver and firmware must match an evidence-backed support-matrix tuple before being called supported.
requiredChecks.evidence: provider/device/driver/firmware identity and qualification evidence reference

requiredChecks.requirement: Required management, integration and output listeners must be explicitly allowed; undeclared public exposure is not accepted by default.
External-control and release/update trust must use the documented production trust paths; test-only trust is not accepted.
requiredChecks.evidence: certificate/key trust identity without private key material

requiredChecks.requirement: Structured diagnostics, support-bundle export and relevant Windows event-log visibility must be verified.
Update discovery must point only to the governed release source and require published production-trusted candidates.
Rollback slot/state snapshot prerequisites must be satisfied before production replacement.
External timing/reference prerequisites must be recorded when required by the selected production configuration.
requiredChecks.evidence: timing/reference configuration and qualification evidence or NOT_APPLICABLE rationale
